name: smwmusic-f-zero-white-land-arrangement
title: F-Zero - White Land (Arrangement)
description:
This is a enhanced arrangement of White Land from the first F-Zero. I decided to do this because I thought the original song really deserved better instrumentation and echo to truly stand out, because the compositions themselves are actually very nice.

Use this if you need a fast-paced chase in a winter level or something; it's not very calm, so it would probably only work on a scenario like that lol
